messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: authz-deps token verification errors in prod — severity P1 — multiple customers reporting login failures. Root at 2004503210. Paging devon_oncall and cj_sre.

devon_oncall: On it. Seeing spike in 401s from API gateways pointing to token verification failures. Console login also failing for a handful of customers.

cj_sre: I can confirm: our jwt-verifier libs are getting signature mismatch errors when fetching keys from Okta (introspect). 429s and intermittent 502s from okta.com/.well-known/jwks.json in eu-west-1.

irene_support: Customer reports: "users can't sign in, onboarding flow blocked" — high impact for a few enterprise customers. Raising priority on comms.

anya_prod: Is this isolated to Okta? Any Auth0 traffic? Need to know scope for status page.

cj_sre: Primary impact is Okta federations — but our authz proxy also calls a 3rd-party session introspect endpoint (auth0) occasionally for legacy tenants and some calls are timing out. So two upstreams showing errors; likely region outage/ratelimit on their infra.

devon_oncall: Quick evidence dump: logs show ~1200 verification fail events in last 3m. Sample error: "signature verification failed: no matching kid in JWKS". Also dozens of 429s on jwks fetch.

ops-bot: Route diagnostics: 5% of traffic failing globally, spike concentrated in EU and US-east. ETA from observability vendor: increased tail latency on HTTP fetches for external JWKS endpoints.

cj_sre: First mitigations: 1) Extend local JWKS cache TTL to 24h to avoid refetches. 2) Enable fallback to cached keys even if kid mismatch if token iss matches and token not expired (strict logging). 3) Serve read-only console pages with cached session cookies where possible. Executing now.

devon_oncall: Commands I'm running:
```bash
# increase JWKS cache TTL in auth-proxy config
curl -X POST https://config.internal/api/v1/flags -H "Authorization: Bearer $CFG" -d '{"auth.jwks_ttl":86400}'
```

devon_oncall: Pushing the config. Rolling restart on small canary. Monitoring.

cj_sre: Also toggling introspect fallback to local verification for cached issuers: set FEATURE_INTROSPECT_FALLBACK=true in k8s.

ops-bot: Canary results: canary saw 80% reduction in 401s after cache TTL bump. No downstream errors observed in 1 node. Proceeding with region roll.

irene_support: Sent initial customer comms to affected accounts: short note + workaround (use SSO link fallback). Product asked for shareable blurb for status page.

anya_prod: Draft for status page: "We are experiencing elevated authentication failures due to intermittent errors and rate limits in third-party identity provider endpoints. We've implemented caching and verification fallbacks to restore sign-ins for most customers. Working with providers and monitoring closely." Thoughts?

irene_support: Good. Add ETA: investigating with vendor, next update in 30m.

devon_oncall: Roll completed across all regions at 2004503320. Overall 401 rate down to baseline ~2%. Some residual errors for tenant A (their Okta org pinned to eu-west-only).

cj_sre: We're opening a support ticket with Okta and Auth0 with logs, user impact, and request for JWKS fetch logs/ratelimit explanation. Ticket IDs will be posted.

ops-bot: Created ticket: OKTA-54231 and AUTH0-98412. Vendor acknowledged and escalated to their infra team.

irene_support: Sending updated customer message with OKTA-54231 and AUTH0-98412 refs and link to status page.

devon_oncall: Temporary mitigation notes for oncall runbook:
- Cache JWKS longer (24h)
- Fallback to cached keys when possible (log with high severity)
- Put rate-limit retries with exponential backoff on JWKS fetch
- If introspect fails, allow short-lived token passthrough for non-critical API routes (feature-flagged)

cj_sre: Add to runbook: proactively prefetch JWKS for major tenants during deploy windows. Also add circuit-breaker when vendor error rate exceeds 5% for >2 min.

anya_prod: For customers needing console access now: temporary measure — enable read-only mode, and for enterprise tenants we can do admin-initiated session migrations using cached tokens. Coordinate with support and sales.

irene_support: Doing that; sending instructions to account teams.

devon_oncall: Post-mitigation checks: auth request success rate 99.2% over last 15m. Console logins still failing for 2 tenants pinned to a single Okta region — working with vendor.

ops-bot: Observability vendor notes: external HTTP fetch latency returned to normal in some regions, but Okta reports throttling due to a config edge issue; they expect a resolution in 2-3 hours.

cj_sre: Filing post-incident followups: 1) Improve JWKS caching and prefetch strategy. 2) Implement safer fallback verification (no accept-unsigned) and tighten audit logging. 3) Add synthetic checks hitting vendor JWKS endpoints and escalate earlier. 4) Update customer-facing runbook for read-only fallback.

anya_prod: Who will own the postmortem?

cj_sre: I'll own the technical writeup. Devon, can you own the customer impact and comms section? Irene will add support timelines.

devon_oncall: Yep. I'll gather tenant lists, affected user counts, and timeline.

irene_support: I'll collect all sent messages and account handoffs.

incident-bot: Incident P1 declared resolved at 2004504325. Actions: runbook tasks created, postmortem due in 72h.

devon_oncall: Closing here. If vendor provides root cause or if residual errors reappear, re-open. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
